subject: Coord: Liaison / Reception SLA for ZenithBank exec day (badge & arrival ops)
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenithbank.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@zenithbank.com
Date: 2027-06-15 09:12 PDT
Subject: Onsite day — security intake & badge handoff

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for confirming the June 22 exec workshop. A couple of quick items from our side so the front-desk and security desk are ready:

- Can you send a one-page visitor intake we can give to reception (photo ID requirements, NDA requirement, expected arrival window)?
- Who will be the Redwood on-site liaison(s) for badge pickup and escort? We need names + mobile numbers for badge pre-approval.
- We require a temporary badge template (we'll pre-print if possible) and a CSV manifest of expected visitors by 9am the day before.
- Any special tech access required (guest WiFi vs segmented lab network) — security wants advance notice if devices will need privileged VLAN access.

Appreciate the checklist. I can loop in Mark in security if helpful.

Best,
Elena Torres
Senior Program Manager, Strategic Partnerships
ZenithBank

From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenithbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-15 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Onsite day — security intake & badge handoff

Hi Elena — thanks for the list. Quick answers below and we'll follow with the files you asked for.

- Liaison: Marissa Cole (on-site logistics) and Stephanie Nguyen (security liaison). Mobile numbers are in my signature block; I can provide direct lines in a separate secure note if you prefer.
- We will attach a temporary badge template and will send the visitor manifest CSV by 09:00 PDT on 2027-06-21.
- Tech access: no privileged VLAN access is required for the workshop — participants will use guest WiFi. If any demo machines require direct network access we will mark them in the manifest and provide MACs in advance.
- Photo ID and NDA: we will require government-issued photo ID at check-in and a one-page mutual NDA signed via DocuSign prior to entry.

Next step: Marissa will send the one-page intake and the manifest template today, and Stephanie will confirm the escort windows with your security team.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0129

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenithbank.com>, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-16 08:22 PDT
Subject: RE: Onsite day — security intake & badge handoff

Hi Elena / team,

Please find attached:
- zenith_temp_badge_template.pdf — our suggested fields for temporary badges (name, org, host, arrival time, expiration, QR code).
- visitor_manifest-zenith-20270622.csv — sample CSV with columns: first_name,last_name,email,company,arrival_time,host,device_mac,requires_demo_access.
- onsite-reception-sla-v1.docx — 1-page reception SLA we propose (check-in steps, ID verification, NDA sign-off link, escort handoff).

Key asks / clarifications:
1) Arrival windows: We'll stage three liaisons for check-in: 08:30–09:30, 11:45–12:30 (lunch arrival), and 13:45–14:30 (late arrivals). Please confirm which door (West Lobby vs Visitor Entrance) you prefer for Redwood arrivals so us and your reception team align.
2) NDA flow: we will send the DocuSign envelope to attendees the morning of 6/21 — guests must complete before badge pickup. Link in my next message.
3) Badge custody: security requested a 24-hour badge custody log for temp badges. We will include badge numbers in the manifest CSV and a signature line for reception.

I attached the draft reception SLA — feel free to redline in comments; short turnaround appreciated.

Marissa Cole
Event Ops Lead — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (650) 555-0873

From: Mark Li <mli@zenithbank.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenithbank.com>, security@zenithbank.com
Date: 2027-06-18 14:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Onsite day — security intake & badge handoff

Marissa — thanks for the files. A couple of notes from Security: 

- West Lobby is preferred for outside partners; we will reserve the side check-in desk for Redwood.
- Please include the license/ID number in the manifest for each guest — our reception will not release a badge without it (scanned or manually recorded).
- For devices that need demo network access, Security needs a device-level justification and a temporary VLAN request submitted by close of business 6/20. If Redwood can provide MAC addresses in the manifest, we can pre-authorize them.
- We will accept the DocuSign NDA but need a copy stored in our compliance folder (please send a PDF when completed).

Also — due to a VIP arrival at 09:00 we require that all Redwood arrivals between 08:30–09:15 be staged at the side conference foyer until security clears the VIP corridor. This is a temporary constraint; please ensure your earliest attendees understand a 10–15 minute wait may occur.

-Mark Li
Security Operations Manager
ZenithBank

From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenithbank.com>, Mark Li <mli@zenithbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-22 16:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Onsite day — security intake & badge handoff

Thanks Mark — understood on the West Lobby and VIP staging window. Final operational notes for today:

- Visitor manifest has been uploaded to the HubSpot record (link below) and CSV sent to reception at 09:00.
- DocuSign NDA sent to all attendees; we'll email a signed PDF to security immediately after the envelopes complete.
- Liaison cell numbers: Marissa Cole +1 (650) 555-0873, Stephanie Nguyen +1 (415) 555-0667, Jonas Weber +1 (415) 555-0129.
- Demo machine MACs included in the manifest for two devices; request for temporary VLAN submitted to security operations earlier today.
- Attachments for reception (badge template, SLA) are attached here for record. Please confirm once reception has printed the badges and completed the custody log.

Appreciate the coordination — we'll be on-site by 08:20 to stage and accelerate check-in.

Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0129
